CODELEARN · F4 — COURSE DETAIL & CURRICULUM

FER202 final assignment (mini LMS) · Function 4 of 11 · Starter = reference of F3 · Suggested time: 75 minutes · Total: 10 marks

1. Overview

Each card's "View details" opens /courses/:id. Show the course information and its curriculum: chapters in order, each with its lessons in order and their durations, plus a total line. json-server 0.17 can nest children for you: GET /chapters?courseId=1&_embed=lessons returns every chapter with a lessons array (child key chapterId).

API calls

RequestWhy
GET /courses/:idcourse fields; 404 ⇒ not found
GET /chapters?courseId=:id&_embed=lessons&_sort=orderchapters + nested lessons (sort the lessons yourself — _embed does not)
GET /categories (or reuse the store)category name — note: _expand=category needs a categories collection lookup that some json-server builds get wrong; a plain lookup is safer

Edge cases

  • Unknown id (/courses/99) and drafts (published:false) ⇒ #course-not-found "Course not found." for everyone except an admin.
  • A course with no chapters ⇒ #no-content "Curriculum coming soon." and "0 lessons · 0 min".
  • useParams() returns strings: "1", not 1.
  • Navigating from course 1 to course 2 must not flash course 1's data.

Main features

  • Route & course data · Curriculum with _embed · Not found, drafts & empty · Redux & structure · Navigation

General requirements

  • Continue from your own F3 code (or the starter, which is the F3 reference). Files marked NEW/EDIT in the tree are the ones this step touches.
  • Create React App (React 18), React Router v6, Redux Toolkit, Axios, React-Bootstrap; json-server 0.17.4 on port 9999 (1.x dropped _expand/_embed).
  • Every HTTP call goes through src/api/*.js (one axiosClient with baseURL: process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL); each API function returns response.data itself — do not rely on interceptors (the auto-grader’s axios does not run them).
  • Keep the ids/classes printed in the brief — the auto-grader uses them. Components never call axios directly.

2. Required project structure

3. UI wireframe

← All courses                                            (#back-to-courses)

│ React for Beginners                (#course-title) │ Free  (#course-price)│
│ [Frontend] Beginner · by Hoang Cuong (#course-meta)│                     │
│ Build your first React apps…  (#course-description)│ (enrol box — F5)    │
│ Curriculum                                    │                     │
│ 5 lessons · 62 min                 (#lesson-count) │                     │
│ ┌ Chapter 1: Getting Started with React ──┐ .chapter / .chapter-title │
│ │ ▶ What is React?                  8 min │ .lesson-item             │
│ │ ▶ Create React App & project…    12 min │                          │
│ └─────────────────────────────────────────┘                          │
│ ┌ Chapter 2: Components, Props & State ───┐                          │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────┴─────────────────────┘

4. Data model

db.json — 8 collections (json-server 0.17.4, port 9999)

FieldTypeNotes
users{ id, fullName, email, password, role: "admin" | "student", active: boolean, createdAt }email stored lower-case and unique · active:false = locked (cannot log in)
categories{ id, name }Frontend · Backend · Database · Mobile
courses{ id, title, categoryId → categories, level, price, instructor, description, thumbnail, published, createdAt }level ∈ Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced · price in VND (0 = Free) · published:false = draft (admin only)
chapters{ id, courseId → courses, title, order }shown sorted by order as "Chapter 1, 2…"
lessons{ id, chapterId → chapters, courseId → courses, title, order, duration (min), videoUrl, content }videoUrl is a YouTube watch link — convert to /embed/<id> for the iframe
questions{ id, chapterId → chapters, courseId → courses, content, options: string[4], answerIndex: 0..3, explanation }one chapter quiz = all questions of that chapter
enrollments{ id, userId → users, courseId → courses, enrolledAt, completedLessons: number[] }progress lives here (ids of completed lessons, sorted, no duplicates)
results{ id, userId, courseId, chapterId → chapters, score, total, percent, passed, answers: number[], submittedAt }one row per quiz attempt · pass mark 70%

    }
  ] /* … 13 rows in db.json */
}

5. Functional requirements

1. Route & course data 2.5 marks

Requirements:

  • Route /courses/:id → pages/CourseDetailPage.js: #course-title, #course-meta (category name · level · "by" instructor), #course-description, #course-price (Free / "199.000 ₫").

Must use: useParams useEffect

2. Curriculum with _embed 3 marks

Requirements:

  • One .chapter#chapter-<id> per chapter with .chapter-title "Chapter N: title" (N = position after sorting by order), lessons as .lesson-item sorted by order with "M min"; #lesson-count "X lessons · Y min".

Must use: _embed reduce

Example:

course 1 ⇒ "5 lessons · 62 min" · Chapter 1: Getting Started with React · Chapter 2: Components, Props & State · Chapter 3: Hooks in Practice

3. Not found, drafts & empty 2 marks

Requirements:

  • 404 or draft (non-admin) ⇒ #course-not-found "Course not found."; no chapters ⇒ #no-content; loading ⇒ spinner (no crash on course === null).

4. Redux & structure 1.5 marks

Requirements:

  • coursesSlice: thunk fetchCourseDetail(id) + detail: { course, chapters, status, error } (pending clears the old course; 404 ⇒ rejectWithValue("notFound")); API functions in courseApi.

Must use: rejectWithValue

5. Navigation 1 mark

Requirements:

  • .btn-detail on the list opens the page; #back-to-courses returns to /courses.

6. Element ids / classes used by the auto-grader

SelectorPurpose
#course-title #course-meta #course-description #course-price #enroll-cardcourse information
#lesson-count · .chapter#chapter-ID · .chapter-title · .lesson-itemcurriculum
#course-not-found · #no-content · #back-to-coursesstates + back link

7. Grading rubric

#FeatureMarks
1Route & course data2.5
2Curriculum with _embed3
3Not found, drafts & empty2
4Redux & structure1.5
5Navigation1
Total10

Common deductions

  • Fetching every lesson of the database and filtering in the browser instead of asking by course.
  • course.title read before the data arrives ⇒ "Cannot read properties of null".
  • Hard-coded http://localhost:9999 in components instead of the .env variable.
  • Mutating Redux/React state, or writing localStorage inside a reducer.
  • App crashes (white screen) on an empty list, an unknown id or a server error.

8. Submission

Work in the editor (files on the right) or download the starter, then npm install and npm run dev (json-server :9999 + React :3000) and paste your files back. Press Run for the sample checks and Submit for full grading (hidden checks included). The reference solution of this step unlocks after an Accepted submission.

1. Tổng quan

Nút "View details" của mỗi thẻ mở /courses/:id. Hiện thông tin khoá và chương trình học: các chương theo order, mỗi chương có các bài theo order kèm thời lượng, và một dòng tổng. json-server 0.17 lồng bản ghi con giúp bạn: GET /chapters?courseId=1&_embed=lessons trả mỗi chương kèm mảng lessons (khoá con chapterId).

Lời gọi API

RequestĐể làm gì
GET /courses/:idthông tin khoá; 404 ⇒ không tìm thấy
GET /chapters?courseId=:id&_embed=lessons&_sort=ordercác chương + bài lồng bên trong (tự sắp bài — _embed không sắp)
GET /categories (hoặc dùng lại store)tên danh mục — tra bằng id cho chắc thay vì _expand=category

Trường hợp biên

  • Id lạ (/courses/99) và bản nháp (published:false) ⇒ #course-not-found "Course not found." với mọi người trừ admin.
  • Khoá chưa có chương ⇒ #no-content "Curriculum coming soon." và "0 lessons · 0 min".
  • useParams() trả chuỗi: "1", không phải 1.
  • Chuyển từ khoá 1 sang khoá 2 không được nháy dữ liệu khoá 1.

Chức năng chính

  • Route & dữ liệu khoá · Chương trình học bằng _embed · Không tìm thấy, bản nháp & rỗng · Redux & cấu trúc · Điều hướng

  • Làm tiếp trên code F3 của chính bạn (hoặc starter = lời giải F3). Tệp đánh dấu NEW/EDIT trong cây là tệp bước này đụng tới.
  • Create React App (React 18), React Router v6, Redux Toolkit, Axios, React-Bootstrap; json-server 0.17.4 cổng 9999 (bản 1.x bỏ _expand/_embed).
  • Mọi lời gọi HTTP đi qua src/api/*.js (một axiosClient với baseURL: process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL); mỗi hàm API tự trả response.data — đừng dựa vào interceptor (axios của máy chấm không chạy interceptor).
  • Giữ đúng id/class in trong đề — máy chấm dùng chúng. Component không gọi axios trực tiếp.
